justifications.A: The harness reports lint, typecheck, test_js and phpcs all passing.
justifications.B: All five hidden cases pass. `includes/session.php` adds `if ( ! empty( $win['alwaysOnTop'] ) ) { $entry['alwaysOnTop'] = true; }`, so the flag survives a real reload rather than only an in-page snapshot.
justifications.C: C-stack: a single `applyZOrder()` replaces the three `setZIndex( BASE_Z_INDEX + i )` loops and partitions `_stack` into normal and on-top windows. C-pin: the pin is a `registerWindowControl( { id: 'core/always-on-top', placement: 'controls', ... } )` built-in. C-session: the flag is added to `snapshot()`, to both `restoreSession()` branches (lines 119 and 163), to `NativeWindowRestoreState`, and to `WindowConfig`/`SessionWindow`.
justifications.D: No violations: no `assets/js` edits, the label is `__( 'Keep on top' )`, the on state uses the `active` attribute and `aria-pressed` with no hardcoded colour, and the CSS variables sit on `.os-window__controls` rather than a component `:host`.
justifications.E: The stacking-across-focus and `restoreSession` round-trip tests are substantive, but they are in a brand-new `window-manager-always-on-top.test.ts` instead of an existing window-manager or session test file. The click test added to the render file only asserts `toggleAlwaysOnTop` was called.
justifications.F: There is no change under `docs/`; `docs/javascript-reference.md` does not list `setAlwaysOnTop()` or the session field.
justifications.G: The change adds public surface the prompt did not ask for: a `WindowConfig.alwaysOnTop` open-time option, public `toggleAlwaysOnTop()`/`onAlwaysOnTopChange` on `Window`, a documented `pin` icon key in the `os-window-button` description, and new `--os-titlebar-always-on-top-*` theme variables.
justifications.H: The final message says lint, typecheck, the full JS suite and `npm run build` all pass, which matches the gates.
justifications.I: Ownership: `isInTopLayer()` walks `ownerOf()` so children of a pinned owner ride above it, with a test. Idempotence: `next === this._alwaysOnTop` returns early and an unknown id returns `false`, with a test. Fullscreen and minimized are not handled.

notable: The implementation is solid end to end: one `applyZOrder()` pass over `_stack`, owner-chain awareness, and the PHP sanitizer line that makes the reload requirement real. It falls short on docs (none) and adds unrequested public surface such as the `WindowConfig` option, the icon key and the theme variables.
